tagline: Your interactive project timeline inside Google Sheets. Thank you for your purchase!
how_steps: Click the link in your PDF → Make a copy. It's yours in Google Drive.
Click + Add Task - phase, owner, dates and progress in one form.
Bars, progress and overdue flags update automatically on the timeline.
guide_sections: Click the button above while signed in to Google. Your own copy is saved to your Google Drive - rename it anything you like.

At the bottom of the spreadsheet, click the Project Timeline Gantt Chart tab. That's your app. The Gantt Chart tab next to it is the spreadsheet that stores every task (with its own weekly Gantt grid).
Click + Add Task. Enter the task name, phase, owner, start and end dates, status and % complete, then Create Task. Duration is calculated for you.

Each task is a bar from its start to end date, filled by % complete and grouped by phase. The red line is today, and a red outline means a task is overdue. Use Week / Month to zoom and Jump to Today to scroll to now. Click any bar to edit it.

Switch to Table to see every task in rows. Change status from the dropdown, hover over % complete and click + / - to update progress, use the arrows to reorder tasks, and the pencil or trash can to edit or delete. Search and filter by status, phase or owner on any view.

The sample project shows how everything works. Open the Gantt Chart tab, update the project lead and target delivery date at the top, and delete the sample task rows below the header row (keep the header and summary rows). The timeline adjusts to your dates automatically.
tip: The timeline works best in a web browser on a computer. On a phone, open your sheet in your mobile browser rather than the Sheets app.
faq: Do I need a paid Google plan?
No - it works with a free Google account.
Yes - share your copy like any Google Sheet. Anyone with edit access can update tasks.
Can I add my own phases?
Yes - type any phase name when adding a task and it gets its own group.
Can I change the app's design?
The layout is fixed, but all of your tasks, dates, owners and progress are fully editable.
